tool_args.rationale: The five rows and signatures indicate a slow-horizon query with a fast transient, but they do not resolve whether the transient is captured by the coarse adiabatic law or the coupled memory ODE. The latter requires more trajectory observations; acquire the fine trajectory batch before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coarse adiabatic slow-ODE or static-linear model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not robustly distinguish this from transient memory dynamics at the forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 4-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archive specifies at least eight rows for that model; only five are available.
It is irrelevant to the identified model ambiguity and explicitly discouraged.
